messages.en: The new guy at the office is called Danish, right?
Yeah, Danish. He's already joined our WhatsApp group.
I got lucky—my wallet was still at the counter.
Phew, what a relief! I thought it was lost. Keep it in your bag from now on.
This watch isn't expensive, but it means so much to me because my late dad gave it to me.
No wonder you take such good care of it. You can't buy memories like that in a shop.
Do we need to dress smartly tomorrow, or can we just wear something casual?
Just wear something casual. We're going to Amir's for a meal.
